description: Record on a Usercase issue that you are fixing it (status fixing, once the user approved the change) or have fixed it (status fixed, with the files, a one-sentence summary for the team, and the pull request link if any). After a finished fix, starting again records the next fix.

files.description: Repository paths of the files changed (or to be changed)

prUrl.description: Pull request link, if one was opened

summary.description: One sentence for the team: what visitors now see differently

name: issue_fix
